projects.title: Molla – Custom WooCommerce E-commerce Theme
projects.overviewHtml: Molla is a custom e-commerce WordPress theme developed specifically for the WooCommerce platform.The theme was built by converting a static HTML template into a fully dynamic WooCommerce-powered CMS, showcasing strong understanding of both:​WordPress Template HierarchyWooCommerce Template Override SystemThe project focuses on clean code, fast performance, and seamless dynamic product integration.No page builders were used — only native WordPress/WooCommerce hooks, PHP, and Pure CSS.

projects.title: EasyBlog – Custom WordPress Theme
projects.overviewHtml: EasyBlog is a custom-developed WordPress theme built to demonstrate mastery of the WordPress Template Hierarchy and PHP development. The project involved converting a static, multi-page HTML/CSS website into a fully dynamic WordPress theme.​Unlike pre-made themes dependent on page builders (Elementor/Divi), this theme relies on Pure CSS and hand-coded PHP templates to ensure maximum performance, semantic markup, and maintainability. It bridges the gap between static design and dynamic content management.

projects.title: 1Cable Network - React + Vite (Headless WordPress)
projects.overviewHtml: 1Cable Network is a headless WordPress application with a React (Vite) frontend for managing WiFi and OTT plans, users, and related workflows. The frontend consumes APIs and emphasizes performance, resilience, and modern UX.

projects.title: Game Dev Landing Page
projects.overviewHtml: This application is a single-page website designed to promote and enroll users in a comprehensive Game Development course. It features sections including a hero section, course listings, testimonials, app download prompts, and a footer. The site is optimized for performance with lazy loading and includes SEO enhancements like a robots.txt file.

projects.title: Architectural & Interior Design Website (Custom WordPress Theme)
techStack: ACF Pro, Custom Post Type, Custom Fields
projects.overviewHtml: I converted a static HTML template into a fully dynamic WordPress theme for an architectural and interior design brand. The site content is fully manageable from the WordPress admin using custom fields and a custom post type for projects.

projects.title: Next.js Dashboard Application
projects.overviewHtml: A modern, full-stack dashboard application built with Next.js 14, featuring authentication, database integration, and real-time data visualization.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.overviewHtml: A modern, responsive portfolio website template for developers and designers to showcase their work.

projects.title: Dynamic Student Record Display
projects.overviewHtml: This project implements a dynamic student table using web technologies. It offers a way to display student data in a clean and potentially interactive manner.

projects.title: Minimalist To-Do List Application
projects.subtitle: A personal project to build a functional to-do list application. This web app allows users to manage their daily tasks efficiently through an intuitive interface, enabling them to add, modify, and track the completion of their activities.
